function: The shape-outside property lets you define a shape for wrapping for the inline content. By default, inline content wraps around its margin box, with shape-outside you can customize this wrapping.

defaults.Animatable: yes for basic-shape. Read about animatable

values.function: This is default. The float area is unaffected. Inline content wraps around the element's margin box
Defines the shape enclosed by the outside margin edge
Defines the shape enclosed by the outside border edge
Defines the shape enclosed by the outside padding edge
Defines the shape enclosed by the outside content edge. Each corner radius of this box is the larger of 0 or border-radius - border-width - padding
The float area is based on the shape of an inset(), circle(), ellipse(), or a polygon() function
